artworks.title: Portrait of a Man
artworks.dimensions:
overall: 65.4 x 91.4 cm (25 3/4 x 36 in.)
framed: 74.9 x 66 x 5.1 cm (29 1/2 x 26 x 2 in.)
artworks.description: The image depicts a man seated with his arms crossed, facing slightly to the side. He has fair skin, a gentle expression, and light-colored hair tied in a small ponytail. He is wearing a dark green coat over a white ruffled shirt with a plain, dark background.

artworks.title: The Hon. Sir Francis Burton Conyngham
artworks.description: The image is a portrait of a man in a three-quarter view. He has neutral facial expression with almond-shaped eyes, a straight nose, and a small mouth. His light-colored hair is styled back with curls framing his face. He wears a dark coat with a wide, red collar over a white shirt. There are no visible jewelry or objects. The background is a muted brown color with no distinct details.

artworks.title: John Stevens (?)
artworks.description: The image depicts a man's upper body, facing slightly sideways towards the viewer. He has distinct facial features with a noticeable nose and a slight smile. He has curled hair framing his face. He is wearing a dark blue coat over a detailed white waistcoat with buttons and embroidery, and a white cravat around his neck. The background is a plain dark brown color.

artworks.title: Charlotte Morton Dexter (Mrs. Andrew Dexter)
artworks.artist: Gilbert Stuart, completed by an unknown artist

artworks.title: Unidentified British Navy Officer
artworks.description: The image shows a portrait of a man from the waist up. He faces slightly left, his left hand on his hip, and his right hand holding a long wooden staff. He has a fair complexion, dark eyes, a rounded face, and dark, curly hair styled in an 18th-century fashion. He wears a blue coat with gold embroidery over a white garment with gold detailing. The coat has wide sleeves with white frilled cuffs and buttons. In the background, there is a hazy seascape with a ship on the right flying a flag, implying a naval context. The backdrop consists of muted blues and browns.

artworks.title: William Seton
artworks.description: The image is a painted portrait of a man seated in a chair. The man has fair skin, a round face, and curly brown hair. He is wearing a dark coat with a high collar over a white ruffled shirt, with a hint of a patterned vest showing. He is holding a white cloth in his hand on his lap. Beside him, there is a table with papers, an inkstand, and quills. The background is a muted green with texture.

artworks.title: Thomas Alston
artworks.description: The image shows a portrait of a person from the waist up. The subject has their head resting on their right hand, propped up on their elbow. Their face is turned slightly towards the viewer, showcasing distinct facial features including dark, well-groomed hair, expressive eyebrows, and focused eyes. The person is wearing a dark jacket over a high-collared white shirt, fastened with visible buttons. In front of them is a stack of books or papers. The background is a warm, earth-toned color. No jewelry or other objects are visible.

artworks.title: Julianna Hazlehurst
artworks.description: The image shows a woman seated, with her left arm on a stone ledge and her right hand holding her left arm. She has smooth skin, dark eyebrows, rosy cheeks, and dark, curly hair styled around her face and gathered at the back. She wears an off-shoulder white dress with puffed sleeves and holds a vibrant red shawl with a floral pattern. The background shows a dusky sky with soft blue, orange, and pink tones, and some greenery in the distance. A stone column is partially visible on the right side.

artworks.title: John Philip Kemble
artworks.description: The image shows a portrait of a person's upper body, capturing their head, neck, and part of their shoulders. The person is positioned facing slightly to the right, with their head turned towards the viewer. They have dark, tousled hair and defined facial features with a focused expression. The individual is wearing a rich, dark red garment draped over their shoulders, with a white collar visible underneath. In their hand, they are clutching the fabric of the garment, and there appears to be an ornate piece near the garment's edge. The background is muted and warm-toned.

artworks.title: Portrait of a Gentleman
artworks.description: The image shows a portrait of a man with a soft, round face, a slightly double chin, small eyes, and a neutral expression. He has gray, voluminous hair styled in the fashion of the 18th century. He is wearing a dark coat with gold buttons and a white ruffled shirt underneath. One hand is hidden under his coat. The background is dark and earthy, centering focus on the subject.

artworks.title: Robert Devereux, 2nd Earl of Essex
artworks.artist: Studio of Marcus Gheeraerts, the Younger
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Mrs. Henry R. Rea
artworks.description: This painting shows a man from the thighs up. He has a fair complexion, curly brown hair, a beard, and a mustache. His brown eyes look out at the viewer. He is wearing an elaborate white doublet with a high ruffled collar, a dark cloak, and a blue ribbon with a colorful medallion around his neck. He also wears a gold belt over white trousers. He is holding the golden hilt of a sword in one hand and has his other hand on his hip. The background is light blue.

artworks.title: Portrait of an Old Man
artworks.creditLine: Gift of George Matthew Adams in memory of his mother, Lydia Havens Adams
artworks.description: This painting shows a close-up of an older man's face with part of his shoulders visible. He is positioned in a three-quarter view, slightly turned to his left, his eyes looking up. The man has pale skin and a full, bushy gray beard and thick, gray hair combed back. His facial features include deep-set eyes, ruddy cheeks, a long nose, and thin lips mostly obscured by his facial hair. His skin has been painted with visible, thick brushstrokes, creating swirling lines. His clothing appears dark and blends into the dark gray background. There is a hint of gray at the bottom, suggesting a gray shirt or tie under a black jacket.

artworks.title: Agnes Gordon Higginson Fuller (Mrs. George Fuller)
artworks.creditLine: Given in memory of the sitter's granddaughter, Agnes Gordon Hilton
artworks.description: The image depicts the upper half of a woman seated in a side profile position, facing to the left. She has fair skin, closed lips, light-colored eyes, and light brown hair styled up. She wears a high-collared dress with lace detailing and a dark shawl draped over her shoulders. She has a brooch with a dangling accessory around her neck. The background is dark with subtle hints of color.

artworks.title: Catharine
artworks.creditLine: Given in memory of Mr. and Mrs. William J. Johnson
artworks.description: This painting is a portrait of a child seen from the waist up. The child is seated, with their body turned to the left but their head facing us. They have a delicate face featuring pale skin, light eyebrows, rosy cheeks, and red lips, along with large, expressive, green eyes. Their face is in a neutral expression. The child has short, dark, curly hair framing their face. They wear a light gray garment with a high collar and a blue tie or cravat around their neck. The background is a blend of dark colors including browns, dark blues, and hints of green. The brushstrokes in the painting are thick and visible, especially those in the background and child's clothes.

artworks.title: Daniel Boardman
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Mrs. W. Murray Crane
artworks.description: A pale-skinned man wearing a white waistcoat, navy-blue coat with tails, knee-length britches, and white stockings stands in front of a deep landscape in this vertical portrait painting. The man nearly fills the right half of the composition. He stands with one ankle crossed in front of the other and his body angled to our left. He looks out at us with brown eyes under wide, dark gray brows. He has a round face with a wide jaw, a straight nose, and his thin, pale pink lips are closed. His gray hair is brushed back from his forehead and sweeps down over his ears. A white cravat is tied in a bow around his neck under a cream-white waistcoat, which is trimmed with pale peach and has two rows of peach buttons down the front. The jacket has gold-colored buttons, and translucent, ruffled cuffs flare out at the wrists. A fob hangs from his parchment-white pants, which are fastened with an oval-shaped, diamond-encrusted buckle on the outside of the knee facing us. His stockings are pearl white, and his black shoes have square silver buckles. He holds a black hat in his left hand, to our right, and his other hand rests on the end of a waist-high wooden walking stick, which angles out to our left where the brass end is braced against the ground. A brown form behind him and to the right could be a column, edge of a building, or a tree trunk. A thick trunk angles out on the far side of his head, and a smaller tree grows up the left side of the composition. Grassy fields reach back to a winding river and a town with a church spire, manor house, and other buildings tucked among hills. Lavender-gray clouds press in to either side of a sunset sky lit pale pink at the center. The artist signed and dated the painting in the lower left corner, "R. Earl Pinxt 1789.”

artworks.title: Interior of a Church
artworks.description: This is a painting of a dark cathedral interior with grand architecture: high vaulted ceilings, arches, columns, and a checkered floor leading to a distant altar near the center of the painting. Light comes in through some arched windows on the left, illuminating patches of the wall, floor, and ceiling. Several people are in the cathedral, walking, sitting, or kneeling by smaller altars. They wear a variety of clothing, some colorful and intricate, others plain and dark.

artworks.title: The Return of the Prodigal Son
artworks.description: A barefoot man wearing tattered clothing, with his hands clasped at his chest, kneels at the feet of an old, bearded man in this almost square painting. The pair is flanked by five people on our right and a man, boy, and calf on our left. All the people have pale skin. The kneeling man faces our right in profile and tilts his head up to look at the old man who embraces him. The younger man has shaggy, dark brown hair and a heavy five o'clock shadow. A small white dog jumps at his dirty, bare feet. The old man has a long gray beard and wears a black skullcap over gray hair. His voluminous dusty rose-pink cloak drapes over a teal-blue robe. To our right of the pair are a child, a woman, and three men. Some look at the embracing men while the others look at each other. At the front of that grouping, two men have brown hair and wispy mustaches. One wears a golden-yellow tunic and holds a silver tray piled with a shimmering sky-blue and pale pink garment, a bright white shirt, and a pair of sandals. Just beyond him and looking into his face, the second man wears gray with a dark green cloak draped over one shoulder. He holds up a gold ring with a ruby-red stone. To our left of the embracing men, a smiling blond boy leads the calf into the scene. Just beyond him is a thin, muscular man carrying an ax over one shoulder as he gazes down at the boy. The scene is set in a courtyard with walls that extend back on either side. Billowing putty-gray and white clouds fill the background.

artworks.title: The David Children
artworks.description: The image displays three children in a domestic setting. One boy is sitting upright, leaning towards a girl who is lying down. He has curly, light-brown hair and wears a red dress with ruffles. The girl beside him has long, dark, wavy hair and wears a light-colored gown. She appears to be holding the baby's hand. The boy is holding the baby's foot and looking kindly at the baby who has light hair and a relaxed expression. The background features a warmly-lit room with a staircase and a doorway. Two people are faintly visible descending the stairs in the adjacent section.

artworks.title: Nonchaloir (Repose)
artworks.description: A woman with pale skin and dark brown hair is swathed in silky fabric as she reclines along a gray couch in this horizontal painting. Her head rests along the backrest of the sofa to our left, so her body extends to our right. Her torso is wrapped in a voluminous, ivory-white scarf or wrap. The scarf wraps tightly around her neck, and the bottom edge, near her knees, has a wide, indigo-blue pattern of ovals and vegetal forms. Her shimmering silver gray skirt is painted loosely with baby and sky blue, olive and sage green, and white strokes, and it drapes over the cushions and down the front of the couch. Her hands are clasped so her interwoven fingers rest at her navel. She looks down and off to our right. A table to our left is edged with gold. The wall behind her, above the couch, is painted with long streaks of eggshell white and pale turquoise. The gold frame of a dark painting hanging over the couch spans the width of the composition. Near the upper right corner of the canvas, the artist included a signature and as if he had signed the painting within this painting with loose, dark letters: “John S. Sargent 1911.”

artworks.title: Alice Butt
artworks.description: The head and shoulders of a young woman with gold-tinted, pale skin looks out over our right shoulder from against a tomato-red background in this vertical painting. The portrait is created with mostly visible, sinuous brushstrokes that make some details indistinct. With her body facing us, the woman nearly fills this composition. She looks in our direction with large, dark eyes under almost flat brows. She has an oval face, a long nose, and her full, slightly downturned coral-red lips are closed. Her chestnut-brown hair falls loosely down her back. Some locks pour over her left shoulder, to our right, and her hair is tucked behind her other ear. Her hair and clothing are especially loosely painted, so it is difficult to make out what she wears. An area of beige could be a scarf draped around her neck and down her front, or a dark, coffee-brown cloak could be open over a lighter garment beneath. The red background is painted with long, visible brushstrokes, and three dark brown spots are clustered against the background over her right shoulder, to our left.

artworks.title: Allegory
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Dr. and Mrs. G. H. Alexander Clowes
artworks.description: A nude woman, pudgy child, and two satyrs, which have men’s heads and torsos with goat’s legs and horns, are in a landscape in this octagonal painting. The scene is divided in half by a tree stump which only reaches to the center of the composition. To the left of the stump, the pale-skinned, nude child stands and hunches over to draw on the ground with a V-shaped compass. Two pieces of paper and a violin lie nearby. The landscape behind him has a body of water leading back to a town with buildings streaked with peach, perhaps flames. A band of peach sky separates the blue silhouettes of mountains lining the horizon from the vivid blue sky above. At the bottom center of the painting, a shield with an oval horizontally striped with red and white leans on the boy’s side of the tree, which has one leafy branch growing on the left side. One satyr holds a jug and kneels close to the tree with his back to it as he looks back over one shoulder. He and the other satyr both have dark, peach-toned skin and full beards. The second satyr hovers to the right of the nude, sleeping woman, both hands reaching for her or the rose-pink cloth surrounding her. The woman has blond curls, a round face, and she sleeps with one hand resting across her belly and her head tipped to our left. The trio are on a grassy area enclosed by dense, dark-green bushes and trees.

artworks.title: Head of a Young Girl
artworks.description: This painting shows a young woman's upper body from the torso up. She is seated and facing the right, with her face seen in profile and one arm bent in front of her, seeming to rest on a brown table or surface. She has pale skin, round, rosy cheeks, a small nose, and pink lips that are slightly parted. Her brown hair is styled into a smooth, glossy bun at the nape of her neck. She is wearing a white garment with thin straps over her shoulders. The background features a yellow section on the bottom half, and on the top half is a colorful, abstract pattern with large, soft, swirling forms in shades of orange and red on a blue-gray background with hints of green.

artworks.title: Captain Patrick Miller
artworks.description: This painting is a portrait of a man standing upright, his chest facing us and his head turned to the left. A horse is positioned directly behind him, and his left arm is lifted, resting on the horse's back. The man has fair skin and wavy gray hair that curls around his ears and seems to be tied behind his neck. He has a slightly flushed complexion, a long nose, pale eyebrows, and lips that seem to be partially open. He wears a formal military uniform, including a brown coat adorned with silver braiding, a brown vest, a pink sash tied at his waist, tan trousers, and tall black boots. He holds a black hat in his right hand. The horse is brown, with its rear visible on the right and its head on the left. The background shows a wooded landscape with dark brown trees and a cloudy red sky.
